patches: all files: intra-package imports relativized (from ifbench import X -> from . import X; from ifbench.instructions import Instruction -> from .instructions import Instruction)

instructions_util.py: removed the import-time download_nltk_resources() call (network side effect); replaced with asserts that vendor/nltk_data ships tokenizers/punkt_tab, corpora/stopwords, taggers/averaged_perceptron_tagger_eng, plus nltk.data.path.insert. The legacy punkt pickle (used only by classic NumberOfSentences via _get_sentence_tokenizer) is deliberately NOT vendored.

instructions.py: upstream created a package-local .nltk_data dir and set NLTK_DATA at import time; replaced with a loud assert on the repo's vendor/nltk_data and nltk.data.path.insert (no directory creation).
instructions.py: emoji and syllapy are not project dependencies; sys.path insertion of vendor/ifbench/_vendor_deps (pip-vendored emoji==2.15.0, syllapy==0.8.0) before importing them.
classic_instructions.py: from absl import logging -> stdlib logging (absl-py not a project dependency); classic checkers are vendored only because instructions_registry imports them.
